regulation.team_composition_text: Each participant must form a team by choosing from the travelers of the trip. The number of travelers to select corresponds to half of the participants minus one (e.g. if there are 4 or 5 travelers, you choose 2; if there are 6, you choose 2; if there are 7 or more, you choose 3).
regulation.captain_text: It is mandatory to assign one traveler in the team as Captain. The bonus and malus points earned by the Captain will be doubled.
regulation.team_registration_text: The team composition and Captain nomination must be confirmed by midnight the day before departure. After that deadline, no changes will be accepted.
regulation.bonus_malus_text: Points will be assigned based on a customized regulation, designed by the travelers.
regulation.special_category_text: After composing their team, each player can participate in the Special Category, an extra section of the game where you bet on a symbolic role among all travelers (even those not in your team). Example: “Who will be the portable first aid?” – i.e. who used the first aid kit the most. Each player can indicate one name and, if at the end of the trip the travelers assign that role to that person, they will earn +10 points. Special Category points are awarded only to players and added to the final score.
regulation.winner_text: The winner is the player who, at the end of the trip, has accumulated the most points, including those from the Special Category.
regulation.ethics_title: Ethics and Spirit of the Game
regulation.ethics_text: The regulation must be interpreted in a playful and respectful spirit. No bonus or malus should ever be seen as an invitation to improper, harmful, or illegal behavior.

description.portable_first_aid: Used the first aid kit more than the tour guide. Band-aids, paracetamol, and 'oh my head hurts' galore.
description.steel_stomach: Ate the weirdest or most suspicious thing without batting an eye… and especially without rushing to the bathroom afterward.
description.the_mover: Came back with a suitcase so heavy that customs almost declared it 'imported goods'.
description.extreme_minimalist: Traveled with luggage so light it looked like they were going away for an afternoon, not a vacation.
description.paparazzo: Captured a companion in such a compromising moment that it will become a meme for years.
description.living_meme: Said or did something that became the official catchphrase of the trip. No one will forget it… even if they want to.
description.odd_sock: Lost more items during the trip (bonus if they were essential).
description.dead_battery: Had the phone dead for the longest time due to zero battery… and never a power bank around.
description.public_restroom_adventurer: Tried the most public/improvised toilets with true adventurous spirit.
description.pro_sleeper: Managed to sleep in the most improbable places and positions.
